title: 7 fully funded PhD student positions in the computational & experimental plant sciences
institution: Max Planck Institute for Plant Breeding Research (MPIPZ), International Max Planck Research School
about: International Max Planck Research School call for seven PhD positions in computational and experimental plant sciences at MPIPZ in Cologne. Applications close 5 January 2027; interviews 15-19 March 2027.
requirements: Master's degree or comparable with 4 to 5 years of relevant university study, awarded before the project starts

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations II
why: "computational & experimental plant sciences" → "Apply causal inference and experimental-design principles through A/B testing, randomized controlled trials, and quasi-experimental approaches to distinguish correlation from causal effects."

"computational ... plant sciences" → "Apply multivariate methods, including principal component analysis, factor analysis, cluster analysis, and discriminant analysis, to explore complex relationships across multiple variables."
